text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 alert - tokenizer_preproc service p99 spike detected in prod region-us-east-1. Condition: p99 > 1.0s for 6m and streaming sessions showing stalls/partial flush. Paging @sam_oncall. alert: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/7410
sam_oncall: acknowledging. I'm on the incident. Pulling traces and logs. Anyone who touched prompt/template pipeline recently?
nina_eng: I merged a change last night that adds per-request tool-schema merging for JSON-mode templates so tools can inject dynamic schemas. Deployed at 01:15 UTC. I did not expect heavy variance in tool payloads.
lee_sre: I'm seeing a burst of template-compile latency around 01:45-02:10 UTC. Template-compiler pod CPU spikes and increased GC in heap profiles. Streaming-init stalls correlate with template compile durations.
jordan_pm: support is seeing customer tickets complaining about partial outputs for long streaming jobs (education customers). We may need to notify impacted customers.
sam_oncall: quick numbers: p95 steady ~140ms, p99 ~1.2-1.4s, streaming rebuffer events up 2.8x. Error rate small bump but significant customer impact for streaming. Root suspect: expensive template compile on cache miss + streaming handshake delay.
nina_eng: sample trace snippet: ```TRACE id=ef56 route=/v1/stream/generate
receive: 12ms
template-compile: 610ms
tokenize: 9ms
stream-handshake: stall 550ms
stream-chunk: 24ms
```
sam_oncall: template-compile is huge. Any cache-miss telemetry?
lee_sre: yes, template-cache misses spike at same time; cache hit rate fell from 98% to 67% in the window. I also see many calls to /compile endpoint returning 503s from overload.
nina_eng: cause hypothesis: cache key currently omits tool-schema fingerprint, so varying tool schemas cause many distinct compile keys and thundering compiles. Also JSON-mode helpers can trigger deeper AST rewrites making compiles heavier.
sam_oncall: immediate mitigations proposed: 1) scale template-compiler horizontally 2) enable aggressive cache-warming for common tool-schema shapes 3) enable streaming-route fallback to simple precompiled template 4) apply compile timeout to avoid blocking streaming. Assigning actions: lee -> scale + cache-warm, nina -> hotfix for compile timeout and fallback header, sam -> route change, jordan -> customer comms.
lee_sre: scaling now: ``kubectl scale deployment/template-compiler -n prod --replicas=8``. Starting a background job to warm cache with common schema permutations (script: ``tools/warmers/schema_warmer.sh``) pointing at shards 0-5.
nina_eng: working on a small patch to enforce compile timeout of 300ms and fallback to `simple_stream_template`. Patch builds locally. Code snippet: ```if (compileDuration > 300) { metrics.increment('compile_timeout_fallback'); return simpleTemplate(); }``` Will open PR and canary. Also adding a header check `X-Stream: true` to skip dynamic schema merge for streaming path.
sam_oncall: making route config change to disable dynamic JSON-mode for streaming once canary validated: ``PATCH /config/routes/streaming { use_json_mode: false }`` (canary first).
jordan_pm: prepping customer notice for impacted accounts. Creating RED-INC-2027 and tagging enterprise support.
lee_sre: scale completed, new pods Ready. Cache-warm job started, pre-warmed ~60% of common keys after 5m. 503s from compile endpoint dropped by ~70% but some misses remain.
sam_oncall: metrics update after scale + warm + route adjust: p99 reduced to ~410ms, p95 ~150ms. Streaming stalls decreased significantly. Still monitoring for tail regressions.
nina_eng: pushing hotfix PR now with timeout + X-Stream skip: https://git.internal/redwood/p/template-compiler/pull/8520 . Adding unit tests and a perf bench for compiled AST sizes.
lee_sre: also adding a temporary RPS throttle on /compile endpoint: ``rate-limit compile 60rps`` via envoy config to prevent thrash while cache-warm completes.
ordan_pm: (typo in message intentionally to be realistic) jordan_pm: correction: RED-INC-2027 created and support notified.
sam_oncall: scribe-bot, capture actions and owner assignments. We'll hold active page and monitor for 45m. If stable, we'll close.
scribe-bot: noted actions: scale template-compiler -> done, start schema cache-warm -> done (in progress), apply compile RPS throttle -> done, route fallback for streaming -> canary applied, hotfix PR #8520 -> open, add compile-time circuit-breaker -> in PR, customer ticket RED-INC-2027 -> created (jordan_pm owner). Postmortem owner to be assigned after mitigation.
nina_eng: root cause plan: include tool-schema fingerprint in cache key, add histogram metrics for compile durations, and add a compile budget circuit-breaker to protect streaming SLA. I will follow up with a full fix PR and rollout plan.
lee_sre: monitoring shows p99 ~320ms and errors back to baseline. We'll keep autoscaling buffer for another 6h and continue warming keys.
sam_oncall: assigning post-incident follow-up: nina_eng to own the engineering fix, lee_sre to own operational docs (runbook updates for cache warming and compile throttles), jordan_pm to lead customer comms. I'll close the page if metrics hold for 45m. Great job team. :thumbsup:
